checks.detail: The test key name must be absent before source creation.
The CNG key must be in the machine key store.
The spike uses Microsoft Software Key Storage Provider.
The machine key must be ECDH P-256.
The CNG export policy must be None.
PKCS#8 private-key export must be rejected.
CNG ECC private-blob export must be rejected.
Existing Sisqual.Credentials entry encryption/decryption must work with the non-exportable CNG key.
